answer: Give every agent a costly, verifiable signal before it can trade: a small stake locked on a public ridge of attestations, where peers inspect timing, behavior, and collateral together. One operator spinning up a thousand fakes must fund each one, and any duplicate proof slashes the whole cluster. Honest agents pay once and then move like a zephyr — light, fast, and trusted — while a sybil swarm collapses under its own weight, because each fake costs real money and leaves a traceable trail.
